physical_dns.scope: selected physical NIC only, plaintext IPv4/IPv6 TCP/UDP53; not DoH/DoT/otherNIC

profile.interpretation: Windows Go sampler includes blocked foreign/syscall stacks;not actual process CPU;cross-check OS process CPU separately

stack_attribution.interpretation: Foreign/syscall sampling may include blocked stacks. Buckets partition sample weight, not actual CPU or a causal latency attribution; crosscheck OS process CPU and diagnostic call/queue measurements. Cumulative rows overlap.

fec_accounting.scope: Full diagnostic lifetime including handshake, DNS, probes and drain. Encoder bytes include56B FEC headers. Observed TCP payload includes TLS overhead and retransmits, excludes TCP/IP headers. Not an exact load-only wire amplification or CPU A/B.

client_allocation.scope: Includes startup/diagnostic lifetime,not precise load-only allocation benchmark
